cases.title: Government social scoring of citizens
cases.ground_truth_basis: Prohibited practice: social scoring by public authorities leading to detrimental treatment.

seat-a.justification: Under Article 5(1)(c) of the EU AI Act, AI systems that evaluate or classify natural persons over a period of time based on their social behavior (social scoring) by or on behalf of public authorities leading to detrimental or disproportionate treatment are strictly prohibited.
seat-a.raw: {"tier": "Unacceptable", "confidence": 1.0, "justification": "Under Article 5(1)(c) of the EU AI Act, AI systems that evaluate or classify natural persons over a period of time based on their social behavior (social scoring) by or on behalf of public authorities leading to detrimental or disproportionate treatment are strictly prohibited.", "key_factors": ["Article 5(1)(c) prohibition", "Social scoring by public authority", "Evaluation of civic behavior", "Detrimental treatment regarding public services"]}

seat-b.justification: The system is a public‑authority social scoring mechanism that determines access to essential services (public housing), which is explicitly prohibited under Article 5 of the EU AI Act.
